# Java 21 patterns — records, sealed types, virtual threads

Curated by Skill Harbor — @gentleman-programming's Java 21 patterns skill: modern, safe code idioms for the agent writing Java 21. Records for immutable DTOs and value objects (with validation in compact constructors), sealed interfaces plus pattern-matching `switch` for exhaustive closed hierarchies, and virtual threads (via `newVirtualThreadPerTaskExecutor`) for scaling blocking I/O without giant thread pools — each shown with good/bad code examples and anti-patterns (mutable DTOs, raw platform threads per request). Ends with a quick-reference table and links to the Java 21 release notes and JEP index. Honest caveats: methodology only — the agent needs a Java 21 project (JDK 21, Maven/Gradle) to apply it to; MIT licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
